headlines.text: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns effective immediately amid Chinese-spy affair scandal; CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO
Nvidia shares plunge as much as 10-12% premarket on Huang's abrupt exit, dragging Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures lower
Wall Street analysts split on Nvidia's outlook as uncertainty over Huang's exit ripples through the AI trade
Nvidia taps outside search firm to find Huang's permanent successor as board weighs internal and external candidates
Red-hot core CPI (+0.3% for a third straight month) pushes December Fed rate-hike odds toward 100%, pressuring futures
AMD, Broadcom shares swing as investors weigh whether Nvidia's leadership turmoil redirects AI chip business their way
